crossRefs.note: I tell you that every idle word that men speak, they will give account of it in the day of judgment.
For by your words you will be justified, and by your words you will be condemned.”
“He said to him, ‘Out of your own mouth I will judge you, you wicked servant! You knew that I am an exacting man…
For he breaks me with a storm, and multiplies my wounds without cause.
Although you know that I am not wicked, there is no one who can deliver out of your hand.
Although there is no violence in my hands, and my prayer is pure.
know now that God has subverted me, and has surrounded me with his net.
“Behold, I cry out of wrong, but I am not heard. I cry for help, but there is no justice.
“As God lives, who has taken away my right, the Almighty, who has made my soul bitter
For Job has said, ‘I am righteous, God has taken away my right:
Will you even annul my judgment? Will you condemn me, that you may be justified?

translations.web: “Do you think this to be your right, or do you say, ‘My righteousness is more than God’s,’
translations.bsb: “Do you think this is just? You say, ‘I am more righteous than God.’
translations.kjv: Thinkest thou this to be right, that thou saidst, My righteousness is more than God's?
translations.asv: Thinkest thou this to be thy right, Or sayest thou, My righteousness is more than God's,
